# Walla Developer Documentation

> Walla is a modern form builder platform. This document covers the Open API and Custom Field SDK.
> Full docs: https://docs.walla.my

---

# Open API

Base URL: `https://api.walla.my/open-api/v1`

## Authentication

Header: `X-WALLA-API-KEY: <your_api_key>`

API keys are team-scoped — team context is automatic. Get your key at https://app.walla.my/open-api/doc

Rate limit: 6000 requests/hour per key.

## Endpoints

### Workspaces

```
GET /workspaces                              → { success, data: Workspace[] }
GET /workspaces/{workspaceId}                → { success, data: Workspace }
GET /workspaces/{workspaceId}/forms          → { success, data: FormWithSettings[] }
```

Workspace: `{ id, name, teamId, createdAt, updatedAt }`

### Forms

```
GET /forms                                   → { success, data: [{ workspaceId, workspaceName, forms }] }
GET /forms/{formId}                          → { success, data: Form }
GET /forms/{formId}/fields                   → { success, data: { fields: Field[] } }
GET /forms/{formId}/fields/{fieldId}         → { success, data: FieldDetail }
GET /forms/{formId}/fields/{fieldId}/description → { success, data: { html, tiptapType } }
```

Form: `{ id, workspaceId, title, description, badge, teamId, creator, lastEditedBy, isDeleted, createdAt, updatedAt }`
Field: `{ id, label, fieldType, outputType }`
FieldDetail: `{ id, label, fieldType, outputSchema, properties, validations, validationErrorMessage, branches, isResponseMasked }`

### Responses

```
GET /forms/{formId}/responses                → { success, data: { responses, pagination } }
GET /forms/{formId}/responses/{responseId}   → { success, data: ResponseDetail }
```

Query params: `page` (default 1), `limit` (default 20, max 100)
Pagination: `{ page, limit, totalCount, totalPages }`
Response fields are dynamic — keys are field IDs, values depend on field type.

### Delivery (requires prior agreement with Walla)

```
POST /forms/{formId}/delivery                → Send form to recipients
GET  /forms/{formId}/delivery                → Get all delivery recipients
POST /forms/{formId}/delivery/status         → Check delivery status by customerKeys
```

Send body: `{ recipients: [{ customerKey, email?, phoneNumber? }], subject?, message? }`
Status values: `NOT_SENT`, `SENT`, `OPENED`, `RESPONDED`

### Field Output Schemas

```
GET /field-output-schemas                    → Field type → output type mapping
```

Output types: `string` (SHORT_TEXT, RADIO, EMAIL, etc.), `array` (CHECKBOX, FILE_UPLOAD), `object` (ADDRESS), `grid` (GRID), `null` (HEADING, DESCRIPTION)

## Error Codes

| Code | Meaning |
|------|---------|
| 400 | Bad request (missing fields, invalid format, bad pagination) |
| 403 | Auth failed or insufficient permissions |
| 404 | Resource not found or form not published |
| 429 | Rate limit exceeded (6000/hr) |
| 500 | Server error (retry with exponential backoff) |

---

# @wallaform/custom-field-sdk

> Lightweight SDK (~35KB) for building custom form fields embedded in Walla forms via sandboxed iframe. Cap'n Web RPC over MessagePort.

## Install

```bash
npm install @wallaform/custom-field-sdk
```

ESM-only. CDN: `import { WallaField } from 'https://esm.sh/@wallaform/custom-field-sdk'`

## Quick Start

```typescript
import { WallaField } from '@wallaform/custom-field-sdk';

const field = new WallaField();

field.onInit(({ properties, value, theme, locale, fieldInfo, formContext, mode }) => {
  if (value) applyExistingValue(value);
});

field.onValidate((submitType) => {
  if (!myValue) return { valid: false, errors: [{ message: 'Required' }] };
  return { valid: true };
});

field.setValue(newValue);
field.setHeight(document.body.scrollHeight);
```

## Constructor

```typescript
new WallaField(options?: { debug?: boolean })
```

Auto-extracts `fieldId` from URL param `?fieldId=xxx`. Waits for MessagePort from host.

## Callbacks (Host → iframe)

```typescript
field.onInit(cb: (payload: FieldInitPayload) => void)
field.onValidate(cb: (submitType: 'next' | 'submit') => ValidationResult | Promise<ValidationResult>)
field.onValueSet(cb: (value: unknown) => void)
field.onDestroy(cb: () => void)
field.onFocus(cb: () => void)
field.onFormValuesChanged(cb: (values: Record<string, unknown>) => void)
```

## Actions (iframe → Host)

```typescript
field.setValue(value: unknown)                // Host auto-saves. 64KB limit, 50ms debounce.
field.setHeight(height: number)              // Clamped 0-5000, throttled 100ms.
await field.uploadBlob(data, mimeType, filename?) // Returns { url }
field.reportError({ message, recoverable })  // Message max 500 chars.
field.destroy()                              // Dispose RPC session.
```

Validate timeout: 10s on host side.

## State Getters

```typescript
field.getProperties<T>(): T
field.getTheme(): WallaFieldTheme
field.getLocale(): string
field.getFieldInfo(): WallaFieldInfo    // { fieldId, formId, label }
field.getFormContext(): { fields: FieldSummary[], values: Record<string, unknown> }
field.isConnected(): boolean
field.getVersion(): string
```

## Types

```typescript
interface WallaFieldTheme {
  background: string; foreground: string; primary: string; primaryForeground: string;
  field: string; fieldForeground: string; border: string; accent: string;
  fontFamily: string; borderRadius: string; direction: 'ltr' | 'rtl';
}

interface WallaFieldInfo { fieldId: string; formId: string; label: string; }
interface WallaFieldValidationError { message: string; itemId?: string; }
interface WallaFieldValidationResult { valid: boolean; errors?: WallaFieldValidationError[]; }

interface FieldSummary {
  id: string; fieldType: string; label: string; description?: string;
  isRequired: boolean; properties: Record<string, unknown>;
  customField?: { typeId: string; typeName: string; outputSchema: Record<string, unknown>; };
}

interface FieldInitPayload {
  protocolVersion: number; mode: 'live' | 'preview';
  fieldInfo: WallaFieldInfo; properties: Record<string, unknown>;
  value: unknown | null; theme: WallaFieldTheme; locale: string;
  formContext: { fields: FieldSummary[]; values: Record<string, unknown>; };
}

type ObserveFieldsMode = 'none' | 'all' | 'configured';
```

## observeFields Policy

- `none`: No form context (standalone fields)
- `all`: All fields/values (SECRETS/PHONE_NUMBER/EMAIL always excluded)
- `configured`: Admin selects specific fields. IDs in `properties._observedFieldIds`.

## Lifecycle

1. iframe loads → SDK waits for MessagePort
2. Host transfers port → RPC session established
3. `init()` → `onInit` fires
4. User interacts → `setValue()` → host auto-saves
5. Submit → `validate()` → `onValidate` returns result (10s timeout)
6. Remove → `destroy()` → `onDestroy` fires → port closed

Conditional rendering: iframe unmounts on hide, remounts with saved value on show.

## Security

iframe sandbox: `allow-scripts` only (no `allow-same-origin`). No localStorage/sessionStorage/IndexedDB. All state via `setValue()`.

## Registration

Custom field type registration requires prior arrangement with the Walla team. Contact us to discuss your use case.
